name: Mall Wet-Umbrella Drip Station
summary: Two-height wet umbrella rack with a pitched drip tray and bilingual wayfinding.
description: Original SG/MY-inspired indoor station with long and compact umbrella slots, five closed umbrellas, ventilated sides, a pitched lift-out drip pan and Malay/English signage. Static, fictional and unbranded.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original Blender meshes, materials, geometry pictogram, bilingual text and true studio render. GLB instances preserve three guide profiles.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Fictional rainy-day indoor fixture. Slots, umbrellas, pan and handle are static visual props with no bag service, plumbing or claim of compliance. Blender metres, +Z up/−Y front; glTF +Y up/+Z front.

attribution.credit: Original Blender geometry, shape pictogram, material palette and studio render. Bilingual sign converted to mesh on export using Blender bundled Bfont. No external models, images, diagrams, artwork or textures.
